overview: Polish /matters/:id detail surfaces for deterministic state/trust/accessibility behavior and finish with final cross-surface exclusion guardrail sign-off.
goals: Standardize state and trust-copy behavior across report/viewer/exports/chat.
Improve action hierarchy and interaction accessibility in detail workflows.
Complete one final exclusion and mandatory-check sign-off.
nonGoals: Parity scope expansion beyond existing cuts.
successMetrics: Detail surfaces pass deterministic state/trust/action checks.
Final guardrail matrix passes with no W-C3/W-C4/W-C5/W-C7/W-C11 violations.
Final sign-off runs only after 0009g1 implementation stories complete.

routes.name: Detail Surfaces
routes.purpose: Primary ownership for report/viewer/exports/chat polish and final guardrail sign-off.

uiNotes: Use shared ui primitives and v5 token/preset conventions.
Keep trust copy source-backed with deterministic fallback text.
Centralize final exclusion matrix in US-004.
rules: One clear primary action per detail-surface context.
No hardcoded trust claims or excluded wireframe behavior.

stories.title: Detail state and trust-copy consistency
stories.description: As an operator, I want deterministic state and trust-copy behavior on detail surfaces so decisions remain reliable.
acceptanceCriteria: Report/viewer/exports/chat states include explicit deterministic guidance.
Example: blocked export state explains reason and next action.
Negative: no hardcoded trust values or generic placeholder states.

stories.title: Detail interaction hierarchy and accessibility polish
stories.description: As an operator, I want clear primary actions and robust non-hover interaction behavior on detail surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: Each context has one clear primary action and visible secondary actions.
Example: viewer close returns focus to invoking element.
Negative: no critical action discoverable only by hover.

stories.title: Detail error/retry/support consistency
stories.description: As an operator, I want deterministic error and recovery behavior across detail workflows.
acceptanceCriteria: ErrorBanner, retry, and support behavior align with 0009f.
Example: non-retryable errors hide retry and show explicit guidance.
Negative: no silent disabled actions or bespoke per-surface error logic.

stories.title: Final cross-surface guardrail sign-off
stories.description: As a product team, we want one final audit confirming mandatory checks and exclusion guardrails across both child slices.
acceptanceCriteria: Guardrail matrix contains pass/fail for W-C3/W-C4/W-C5/W-C7/W-C11 with evidence links.
Example: audit confirms no hardcoded ingest stats and no unsupported upload claims.
Negative: no final sign-off with unchecked exclusion rows or open 0009g1 implementation stories.
